description: This Java class 'ViewAnimations' is part of an Android application demonstrating how to implement various view animations using the Android SDK's pre-3.0 animation classes. It creates UI buttons that, when clicked, animate with different effects such as fade, translate, rotate, scale, or a sequence of animations. The class also loads animation resources dynamically based on user input.

classes.name: ViewAnimations
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating various view animations triggered by button clicks, including fade, translate, rotate, scale, and combined animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and prepares predefined animations for triggering.

methods.name: setupAnimation
methods.description: Attaches a click listener to a view that starts either a custom animation or an animation loaded from resources based on checkbox state.
